blocks.text: 2 Samuel 17 contains 29 verses. It opens with: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night: It concludes with: and honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people are hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Second Samuel moves from David's accession and kingdom consolidation through ark and dynasty promise to royal abuse, household violence, rebellion, grief, and a four-part closing appendix.
